description: The Erasing of  MacBook data and resetting it to factory settings involves many steps. It requires signing in with your admin credentials, backing up data, reviewing what will be erased, and confirming the reset. After following all the steps, the MacBook will restart, erase all data, and return to a setup screen like a new device.
title: How to Prepare Your MacBook for Sale or Trade-In: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: An Atlas V rocket has successfully launched 29 satellites for Project Kuiper, marking its return to flight after nearly three years. The mission matched the rocket’s payload record and expanded the growing broadband constellation. The satellites will raise their orbits to operational altitude, helping deliver global internet coverage and improving connectivity in remote and underserved regions worldwide as the company continues deploying more satellites to build a competitive space-based communications network in the coming years.
title: ULA Atlas V Launches 29 Amazon Kuiper Satellites in Return Mission

description: Motorola has launched the Moto Buds 2 Plus in India at Rs. 5,999, with sales starting May 8 via Flipkart. The earbuds feature a hybrid dual-driver setup tuned with Sound by Bose, support Hi-Res Audio with the LHDC codec, and offer up to 55dB adaptive active noise cancellation. They include Bluetooth 6.0, dual device pairing, and app-based features like custom EQ, gaming mode, and AI tools. The earbuds deliver up to eight hours of playback and up to 40 hours with the charging case.
title: Moto Buds 2 Plus Launched in India With Hi-Res Audio, Up to 40 Hours of Total Playback Time: Price, Features

description: A joint operation involving authorities from the UAE, the US, and China led to the shutdown of nine crypto scam centres and the arrest of 276 individuals. The crackdown targeted fraudulent investment platforms and cross-border money laundering activities linked to crypto scams.
title: Nine Crypto Scam Centres Targeting US Users Shut Down in Joint Operation Involving UAE, US and China

description: A security engineer has found a way to install Linux on a PS5 and turn it into a Linux PC that can run Steam games. The engineer has publicly released the Linux loader on GitHub. The loader supports the original PS5 model and leverages a vulnerability in the console.
title: PS5 Linux Loader Gets Public Release, Allowing Users to Run Steam and PC Games on Console

description: Samsung has started developing a new Galaxy Book lineup, which will run on Android, according to a report. The South Korean tech giant is said to be working on three Android-based Samsung Galaxy Book models, which will likely include a low-cost variant, a mid-range model, and lastly a flagship variant, similar to the company’s Ultra, Pro, and standard Galaxy Book 6 models. The rumoured Android-based Galaxy Book lineup will reportedly ship with Android 17-based One UI 9, while boasting Galaxy AI features.
title: Samsung Reportedly Plans to Launch Galaxy Book Models With Android-Based One UI 9 Soon

description: iQOO Z11 could launch in the global market soon. Ahead of the formal announcement, the handset was spotted on the Geekbench database with a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset. The China variant of iQOO Z11 has a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 chipset under the hood. The listings also suggest that the iQOO Z11 might run on Android 16 with 12GB RAM. It was launched in China last month with a 6.83-inch AMOLED display and a 9,020mAh battery with 90W fast charging support.
title: iQOO Z11 Global Variant Spotted on Geekbench Database With Snapdragon Chipset, Unlike Chinese Model

description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman teased the successor to the GPT-5.4 Cyber artificial intelligence (AI) model on Thursday. Dubbed GPT-5.5 Cyber, the model was announced just a fortnight after the San Francisco-based AI giant introduced its first cybersecurity model. Not a lot is known about the model currently, but it is expected to follow the same limited release format as the predecessor.
title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Teases GPT-5.5 Cyber AI Model Rollout, Could Take On Anthropic’s Claude Mythos

description: Vivo X Fold 6 has surfaced in leaks suggesting upgrades across display, performance, and battery. The foldable is tipped to feature an 8.02-inch 2K inner screen, a 6.51-inch outer display, and a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset. It may include a triple rear camera setup led by a 200-megapixel sensor, along with dual 20-megapixel front cameras. The handset is also expected to pack a battery close to 7,000mAh, support wireless charging, and offer water resistance, with a possible China launch in June.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Leaks Hint at 200-Megapixel Camera, MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chip and 7,000mAh Battery

description: Google Photos will soon roll out a new artificial intelligence (AI) feature to help users decide what to wear. The feature brings several existing AI tools together to let users digitise their entire wardrobe and mix and match clothes virtually to create new outfits without the hassle of manually wearing clothes.
title: Google Photos Unveils New AI-Powered Wardrobe Feature to Help You Decide What to Wear

description: Sony has broken its silence over the DRM controversy that has sparked backlash from PS5 and PS4 users. Recent reports claimed that the company had implemented a new DRM-check for digital purchases that would require users to verify new purchases online every 30 days. Now, Sony has issued a clarification on the issue.
title: Sony Issues Statement on New DRM Check for PS5, PS4 Games After Backlash

description: Moto G37 and Moto G37 Power launched with MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipsets. They come with a 6.67-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate and have  50-megapixel rear camera units. The Moto G37 Power has a 7,000mAh battery, and the Moto G37 has a 5,200mAh battery with support for 20W fast wired charging. The duo offers an IP64 rating for dust and water resistance and MIL-STD-810H certification.
title: Moto G37 Power Launched With 7,000mAh Battery Alongside Moto G37: Price, Specifications

description: Moto G47 has been launched globally as the company’s latest addition to its mid-range G lineup. The handset is set to go on sale in select global markets via the company’s website in Pantone Fuchsia Red, Pantone Impenetrable, and Pantone Nautical Blue colour options. The new Moto G series smartphone is powered by a 6nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.4GHz. The handset also features an ARM Mali-G57 MC2 GPU, 8GB of LPDDR4x RAM, and 128GB of storage. The Moto G47 carries a triple rear camera unit, with a 108-megapixel primary shooter, a 2-megapixel macro camera, and a 2-in-1 light sensor.
title: Moto G47 Launched With 108-Megapixel Camera, 5,200mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Raakaasa is a Telugu horror-comedy film that stars Sangeeth Shobhan in the lead role. The film explores themes of humor, horror, and comedy.
title: Raakaasa OTT Release Date Confirmed: Know When and Where to Watch it Online

description: CMF has confirmed the launch of its next smartwatch, the CMF Watch 3 Pro, in India, following its global debut in July 2025. While the company has not yet revealed the launch date, it has teased key features of the Watch 3 Pro, claiming it to be its most advanced smartwatch to date. The CMF Watch 3 Pro will be available for purchase via Flipkart, with more details regarding pricing and availability expected to be announced soon.
title: CMF Watch 3 Pro India Launch Finally Confirmed; Will Feature AMOLED Screen, Up to 13 Days of Battery Life

description: Motorola has launched the Moto G87 with a 200-megapixel main camera, a 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED display, and IP66, IP68, and IP69 durability ratings. Priced at GBP 349.99 (roughly Rs. 45,000) for the 8GB + 256GB variant, the phone is listed but not yet on sale. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset with Android 16 and packs a 5,200mAh battery with 30W charging, along with stereo speakers, AI tools, and enhanced camera features.
title: Moto G87 Launched With 200-Megapixel Main Camera, 5,200mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Motorola Razr 2026 series has been launched globally by the tech firm as its latest clamshell foldable lineup. The series includes three models, dubbed Motorola Razr Ultra 2026, Razr+ 2026, and Razr 2026. All three models will be available for pre-order in the US via the company’s online store and authorised retail outlets starting May 14. The Motorola Razr 2026 is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7450X chipset, paired with a 4,800mAh battery. Meanwhile, the Razr Ultra 2026 and Razr+ 2026 are equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite and Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipsets, respectively.
title: Motorola Razr Ultra 2026, Razr+ 2026 Launched With 4-Inch Cover Display, Razr 2026 Tags Along: Price, Features

description: HKMA, HSBC, and Anchorpoint Financial have warned users about fake stablecoins circulating under the tickers “HKDAP” and “HSBC.” The regulators clarified that no official tokens have been launched yet and urged users to rely only on authorised channels.
title: HKMA Warns Investors of Fraudulent HSBC and Anchorpoint Stablecoins

description: House of the Dragon Season 3 is an epic fantasy drama set before Game of Thrones, focusing on the Targaryen dynasty’s decline.
title: House of the Dragon Season 3 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Google is adding new capabilities to its TV platform, including a dedicated row for YouTube Shorts and a set of Gemini-powered creative tools. Users will be able to generate images with Nano Banana and create videos using Veo directly on their TV. The update also enhances Google Photos with voice search, stylised edits, and improved slideshow options. These features are designed to make Google TV more interactive and better suited for both content creation and personal media viewing.
title: Google TV Update Adds YouTube Shorts, Nano Banana and Gemini AI-Powered Veo Features

description: Bitcoin traded near $75,600 on April 30 after the US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged and flagged inflation risks. ETF outflows and macro uncertainty weighed on sentiment, with analysts saying the market remains range-bound.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $75,600 as US Fed Holds Rates Steady, ETF Demand Weakens

description: iQOO Neo 10 is now available in new Alpine White and Asphalt Black colour options in India. The new variant costs Rs. 37,999 for the 8GB RAM + 256GB storage variant. The new colour options will sit alongside the Inferno Red and Titanium Chrome colour options that have already been available in India since the phone's launch in India in May last year. Key specifications of the phone include a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, up to 16GB RAM, a 7,000mAh battery and a 50-megapixel dual rear camera unit.
title: iQOO Neo 10 Gets New Alpine White, Asphalt Black Colour Options in India: Price, Specifications

description: Exam is an upcoming Tamil socio-thriller series that is about to make its debut on Amazon Prime Video. The show consists of seven episodes and explores the themes of infiltration of the paper-leak scam.
title: Exam OTT Release Date Confirmed: All You Need to Know About This Upcoming Tamil Original Web Series

description: Oppo Find X10 is expected to go official later this year. A new leak states that the phone is undergoing testing with a 200-megapixel main rear camera with a 1/1.4-inch sensor. Oppo could pack either a 200-megapixel periscope camera with a 1/1.56-inch sensor, or a 64-megapixel periscope camera with a 1/2-inch sensor in this upcoming phone. Another leak claims that the phone will have a flat display with a 165Hz refresh rate. It is expected to ship with a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 chipset.
title: Oppo Find X10 Leaks Hint at 165Hz Display and New Periscope Telephoto Camera

description: Divine, a reboot of Vine backed by Jack Dorsey, is rolling out with support for new uploads and a restored archive of 500,000 videos from nearly 100,000 creators. The app reportedly focuses on open protocols, limits AI-generated content, and introduces features like compilation mode. Built on Nostr, it aims to support decentralised social networking while giving creators more control over their content and future monetisation options.
title: Jack Dorsey-Backed Divine Brings Popular Vine Platform Back to Life Using Open Protocols

description: Apple could be reconsidering one of its most popular iPhone features, MagSafe, which has become a staple on modern handsets. According to a tipster, there is an internal debate within the Cupertino-based tech giant about whether it should continue to be a standard feature on future models. Given how widely MagSafe has been adopted across accessories and third-party ecosystems, the move, if it comes to fruition, could mark a significant shift in Apple’s hardware strategy.
title: Apple's Future iPhone Models Could Arrive Without MagSafe Despite Ecosystem Growth, Tipster Claims

description: Sony has announced the PS Plus monthly games lineup for May. On May 5, EA Sports FC 26, Wuchang: Fallen Feathers, and Nine Sols will join PS Plus. PS Plus monthly games for April will be available till May 4.
title: PS Plus Monthly Games for May Include EA Sports FC 26, Wuchang: Fallen Feathers and Nine Sols

description: The OnePlus Pad 4 was launched in India on Thursday. The tablet sports a 13.2-inch 3.4K LCD screen with a 144Hz adaptive refresh rate. It is powered by Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, coupled with up to 12GB of RAM. OnePlus has equipped it with several productivity-focused features, enabling PC-like capabilities. The OnePlus Pad 4 comes with the OnePlus Stylo Pro stylus, which is claimed to offer improved pressure sensitivity and a refined tip for better precision.
title: OnePlus Pad 4 Launched in India With 144Hz LCD Screen, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Google, on Wednesday, announced the quarterly financial results for Q1 2026. During the earnings call with investors and analysts, company CEO Sundar Pichai announced that the company increased its consolidated revenue by 22 percent year-over-year (YoY) to clock $109.9 billion (roughly Rs. 10.48 lakh crore) in the first quarter of the ongoing year.
title: Google Hits 350 Mn Paid Subscriptions Across Services, Search Queries ‘All Time High’: Sundar Pichai

description: Valathu Vashathe Kallan is a Malayalam crime thriller that explores a strained father-son relationship alongside a sensitive criminal case. Starring Biju Menon, the film dives into emotional conflict, justice, and societal pressure. Streaming on Aha Tamil, it has received mixed reviews and holds an IMDb rating of 6.1 out of 10.
title: Valathu Vashathe Kallan OTT Release: Where to Watch Malayalam Crime Thriller Online

description: Xiaomi has announced the Android 17 Developer Preview Programme for four Xiaomi smartphones in select global markets. The list of devices now eligible to receive future Android 17 beta updates includes the Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Xiaomi 17 Ultra Leica Edition, Xiaomi 17, and Xiaomi 15T Pro. Devices enrolled in the programme can download the beta version of the upcoming Android 17 version, allowing users to experience the OS and provide feedback before it is released to a wider user base. This comes after Motorola and Google announced the Android 17 beta programmes for their handsets.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Xiaomi 17 and Xiaomi 15T Pro Are Now Eligible to Receive Android 17 Beta Updates

description: Motorola launched a new Brilliant Collection featuring the Motorola Signature and Moto Buds 2 Plus. They are unveiled in a new Pantone Violet Indigo finish and will go on sale in select regions in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America and Asia-Pacific in the coming weeks. The Swarovski Crystals are placed in a 3D-quilted pattern in the devices.  The handset has 20 hand-placed Swarovski Crystals on the rear, while the audio device has 12 Swarovski crystals on each earbud. The case has 41 hand-placed Swarovski Crystals surrounding the logo.
title: Motorola Signature, Moto Buds 2 Plus Now Available in Swarovski Crystal-Studded Brilliant Collection

description: Qualcomm said on Wednesday that its third quarter results will be lower than expected, but CEO Cristiano Amon gave a positive view about a recovery in smartphone sales and growth in data centres, pushing shares up 15 percent after hours. The company has faced uncertainty as rising memory chip prices increased device costs, leading customers to cut spending on phones and PCs.
title: Qualcomm Rises on Smartphone Rebound Hopes, Data-Centre Chip Push

description: Intel Core 5 320 processor, codenamed Wildcat Lake, has reportedly been listed on the PassMark benchmarking platform. The unreleased processor is expected to compete with the MacBook Neo’s Apple Silicon A18 Pro chipset. The unreleased Intel processor is said to feature a six-core CPU, comprising two efficiency cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 4.6GHz, and four efficiency cores. The A18 Pro SoC also features a six-core CPU. However, Intel has yet to confirm the anticipated release of the new Intel Core 5 320 processor.
title: Intel's 'Wildcat Lake' Processor Shows Up on Benchmark Database, Could Rival A18 Pro Chip on MacBook Neo

description: Apple is said to be heading into one of its most challenging supply chain phases. According to a report, global memory shortage threatens to increase the cost of future iPhones significantly. The primary culprit is likely to be the memory component, which, historically, accounted for a relatively small portion of smartphone manufacturing costs. However, it may reportedly account for nearly 45 percent of an iPhone’s total value by 2027, as demand for AI data centres continues to rise.
title: Memory Component to Reportedly Account for 45 Percent Value of an iPhone Due to Supply Chain Issues

description: Google on Wednesday rolled out a new feature for the Gemini app that allows users to generate and export files directly from chat. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, its new addition makes it easier to turn ideas into shareable documents. Users can create downloadable files such as PDFs, Microsoft Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and Google Workspace files with a single prompt. Google says they can move from brainstorming to a finished file without needing to switch between apps.
title: Gemini Now Lets Users Generate and Export Files With Support for PDF, Word Formats
